what: When the map section enters the screen the pin appears, and behind it an accent-color soft glow spreads from 0 to full size over 3s (linear). In the always type it repeats every 3s while in view — for service-area and store-location maps

options.loop: If always, repeats while it stays attached (default is once)
options.[data-fx-part=pin]: Pin (child) — inner image appears, glow behind it

from.where: index.js·index.css #home_area .map-pin (clinic pin on the teal region band)
